title: Termination of a Professional Services Projects Engagement and Cancellation Fees
content:
A client ends a Professional Services Projects engagement only by a signed termination notice, effective on the day it is signed.

## Cancellation fee

- **Before kickoff**, the cancellation fee is the class's before-kickoff percentage of the contract value.
- **After kickoff**, it is the class's after-kickoff percentage of the contract value minus everything already billed by deposit, milestone and time-and-materials invoices, and the work performed but not yet invoiced is billed as well: completed milestones not yet invoiced, and logged time-and-materials time.
- Each amount is rounded half up to the cent; a fee of zero is not posted.

| Termination takes effect | Base of the cancellation fee | Also billed |
|---|---|---|
| before kickoff | the contract value | nothing further under this clause |
| after kickoff | the contract value minus everything already billed by deposit, milestone and time-and-materials invoices | completed milestones not yet invoiced, and logged time-and-materials time |

## Deposit and credit memos

A paid deposit is applied to what the client owes on the engagement, and any paid amount above it is refunded by a credit memo against the deposit invoice. A charge is reversed by credit memo at most once; whether a charge has already been reversed is read from the engagement's billing, where each credit memo names the charge it reverses.

## Termination by Stratton Bay

A termination by Stratton Bay after a hold longer than the class hold limit is treated as a client cancellation.

## Worked examples (hypothetical figures)

- Before kickoff, on a contract value of 20000.00 with a before-kickoff percentage of 10 percent, the fee is 2000.00.
- After kickoff, on a contract value of 100000.00 of which 45000.00 has been billed by deposit, milestone and time-and-materials invoices, with an after-kickoff percentage of 20 percent, the fee is 20 percent of 55000.00, that is 11000.00, and any completed milestone not yet invoiced and any logged time-and-materials time are billed as well.
- With a before-kickoff percentage of 0 percent the fee is zero, and no fee is posted.
